mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) from prior month indicate housing sector contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing sector weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during supply contraction regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increase above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth exceeding 2.0% indicates inflation-fueled monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized) during expansionary demand regimes supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
